result.analyst_notes: Factual, asset- and scale-focused corporate voice using first-person plural 'we' and a mix of descriptive claims and 'committed to' statements. Shareholder and financial-strength framing dominates the opening, while employees, customers, DEI and environment are absent from the About text. Commitments are stated without hedging. Sustainability appears only in headline and teaser text.
